mapper.sql: s.id, s.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.department_id, dep.name AS department_name, s.clinic_room_id, r.name AS clinic_room_name, s.shift_template_id, t.name AS shift_name, s.work_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sl.total_capacity) FROM med_slot sl WHERE sl.schedule_id = s.id), FLOOR(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(s.end_time, s.start_time)) / 60 / NULLIF(s.slot_duration_minutes, 0)) * s.capacity_per_slot, 0) AS total_capacity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sl.remaining_capacity) FROM med_slot sl WHERE sl.schedule_id = s.id), FLOOR(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(s.end_time, s.start_time)) / 60 / NULLIF(s.slot_duration_minutes, 0)) * s.capacity_per_slot, 0) AS remaining_capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_appointment a JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id = a.slot_id WHERE sl.schedule_id = s.id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'BOOKED')) AS active_appointment_count, s.cancel_reason

mapper.sql: FROM med_appointment a JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id = a.slot_id JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id = sl.schedule_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id JOIN med_clinic_room r ON r.id = s.clinic_room_id LEFT JOIN med_encounter e ON e.appointment_id = a.id WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.work_date = #{workDate}

SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, a.slot_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department_name, r.name AS clinic_room_name, s.work_date, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, a.status, a.confirm_deadline, a.cancel_deadline, e.id AS encounter_id, e.status AS encounter_status
ORDER BY sl.start_time, a.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
